title: UPDATE: Micro1 Commits $1 Billion for Company Data After Crossing $1B ARR
summary:
The demand for expert human training sets drove a growth in revenue from $500 million in August to $700 million just a few weeks later. Micro1 has since surpassed $1 billion in annual recurring revenue and announced a commitment to spend $1 billion on acquiring proprietary company data to support AI laboratories. This expansion is primarily driven by the company's Data Partnerships program, which licenses business datasets for use in AI model training.

The company closed a Series B funding round earlier this summer at a $4 billion valuation. This scaling occurs as laboratories prioritize high-quality data to improve model performance, with analyst Ali Sarinik estimating that as much as 10% of US GDP could soon be dedicated to training AI models.
